newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Aerolineas says American to buy 10 pct of holding.
newsitem.headline: Aerolineas says American to buy 10 pct of holding.

text.p: American Airlines will buy 10 percent of the holding company of Aerolineas Argentinas in a deal signed by American and Aerolineas's operator, Iberia, Aerolineas said Friday.
"Under the new structure (American) will obtain 10 percent of Interinvest," Aerolineas President Manuel Moran said in a press release. Interinvest is the holding company for Aerolineas.
An Aerolineas spokesman told Reuters that the deal also implies the Spanish carrier Iberia Lineas Aereas de Espana SA swapping its 20 percent stake in Aerolineas for a 10 percent in Interinvest.
Last week Moran said the remainder of Interinvest not owned by Iberia or American, a unit of AMR Corp, would be placed on the market.
Interinvest, which owns a 63.35 percent of Aerolineas, was formed by the Spanish state (40 percent), Merrill Lynch & Co Inc (45 percent) and Bankers Trust New York Corp (15 percent).
The Argentine state owns five percent of Aerolineas. The company's employees have 10 percent, and other Argentine investors the remaining 1.65 percent.
